# Dharma's Dog Pods

> Handmade custom fibreglass dog pods (dog carrier boxes) built in Bali, Indonesia. Fitted to any moped, scooter or motorbike — Honda Vario, Scoopy, PCX, Yamaha NMAX, Aerox, Fazzio, Vespa and more. Built by Dharma in 4–7 days. Single-side from IDR 2,400,000, double-side from IDR 3,400,000. Optional bike pickup & drop-off across Bali (extra IDR 450,000–750,000 depending on location). Contact via WhatsApp +62 818 0802 9595.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Dharma's Dog Pods
- **Owner:** Dharma
- **Location:** Bali, Indonesia
- **Areas served:** Canggu, Pererenan, Ubud, Uluwatu, Seminyak, Denpasar, Sanur, and the wider island of Bali
- **WhatsApp / phone:** +62 818 0802 9595
- **Website:** https://dogpodsbali.com
- **Material:** Hand-laid fibreglass with UV-stable gel coat (waterproof, mould-proof, lighter and stronger than wood/plywood)
- **Lead time:** 4–7 days average to build and fit
- **Pricing:** Single-Side Pod from IDR 2,400,000. Double-Side Pod from IDR 3,400,000. Final price depends on bike model and dog size.
- **Optional pickup/drop-off:** IDR 450,000–750,000 depending on location in Bali
- **Customisations:** any colour, clear acrylic windows, ventilation upgrades, padded interiors, harness clips, drainage, custom sizing for small/medium/large dogs, name plates, waterproofing, reflective trim
- **Bike fitments:** Honda Vario, Scoopy, PCX, BeAT, Genio, ADV; Yamaha NMAX, Aerox, Fazzio, Mio, Lexi; Vespa LX/Sprint/GTS; Kawasaki, Suzuki, Royal Enfield — and most other 125cc–250cc scooters and motorbikes available in Indonesia
